samples with cumulative lick >2\" |\n| Track length | 450 cm | \"450 cm linear track\" |\n| Reward zone width | 50 cm | \"hidden, unmarked 50 cm span\" |\n| Zone A | 80-130 cm | From code and paper |\n| Zone B | 200-250 cm | From code and paper |\n| Zone C | 320-370 cm | From code and paper |\n| Teleport jitter | 1-5 s (5-10 s after omission) | From methods |\n| Interneuron exclusion | 0.42 +/- 0.85% | \"Pearson correlation >0.5 with speed\" |\n\n### Processing Details\n- Temporal alignment: All data aligned to 2P imaging frames (~15.5 Hz)\n- dF/F computed per trial with maximin baseline (20s sliding window)\n- Deconvolved with OASIS (suite2p implementation)\n- Activity outside trial periods set to NaN (teleport periods excluded for most sessions)\n- Auto-reward on first 10 trials of new condition\n\n### Curation Steps\n\n**Neuron curation rules**:\n1. Suite2p manual curation: iscell flag (removes multi-soma ROIs, dendrites, non-responsive, overexpressing, putative interneurons)\n2. Speed-correlated interneuron exclusion: Pearson r > 0.5 between dF/F and running speed (~0.42% excluded)\n\n**Trial curation rules**:\n1. Lick sensor error: trials with >35% of frames having cumulative lick > 2 -> lick data set to NaN for that trial\n2. All valid trials (trial_number >= 0) included\n\n### Decoders Trained in Paper\n| Decoded variable | Method | Notes |\n|---|---|---|\n| Circular reward-relative position | Circular-linear regression | cos(y - y_hat) score, ~0.1-0.6 for RR cells |\n\n---\n\n## Step 4: Check for Consistency\n**Status**: COMPLETE\n\n### Discrepancies Found\n| Topic | Code says | Data shows | Paper says | Resolution |\n|-------|-----------|------------|------------|------------|\n| NWB Deconvolved | Raw suite2p deconv (no NaN in ITI) | Values 0-2484, no NaN | Custom dF/F + OASIS | Must recompute dF/F from F and Fneu |\n| Neurons/session | iscell filter | 155-2281 per session | 155-2172 | Close match; slight difference may be from interneuron exclusion |\n| m18 iscell count | 2281 in iscell but only 1994 in plane0 data | Multi-plane: iscell=4857 total, 2281 cells | Planes pooled | iscell covers both planes; need to use planeIdx to map |\n| Trials per session | Some sessions have fewer: m4-ses-04=41, m4-ses-09=50, m13-ses-13=60 | 41-100 | 80.5 +/- 7.4 | Some sessions ended early; include all |\n| Environment encoding | env=0 or env=1 in NWB | -1 before scanning | ENV1=0, ENV2=1 | Use env value per trial (ignoring -1) |\n\n### Key Consistency Check\n- Paper says 11 switch mice, data has 11 subjects -> consistent\n- Paper says ~80 trials/session, data shows mean 80.4 -> consistent\n- Paper says 155-2172 neurons/session, data shows 155-2281 (before interneuron filter) -> consistent\n\n---\n\n## Step 5: Mapping Planning\n**Status**: COMPLETE\n\n### Variable Mapping\n\n| Source Variable | Target Field | Transform | Notes |\n|-----------------|--------------|-----------|-------|\n| Custom dF/F + OASIS deconv of F, Fneu | `neural` | Compute dF/F with maximin baseline, deconvolve, filter by iscell | Shape: (n_neurons, n_timepoints) per trial |\n| Timestamps within trial | `input[0]`: time_from_trial_start | (frame_idx - trial_start_idx) / imaging_rate | Continuous, time-varying |\n| NWB environment | `input[1]`: environment_type | 0=ENV1, 1=ENV2 | Binary, per-trial |\n| NWB trial number | `input[2]`: trial_number | 0-indexed trial number | Continuous, per-trial |\n| Previous trial reward | `input[3]`: previous_trial_outcome | 0=omitted, 1=rewarded | Binary, per-trial |\n| Position vs reward zone | `output[0]`: distance_to_reward_zone | Discretize signed distance to nearest rz boundary into 7 bins | Time-varying |\n| NWB position | `output[1]`: absolute_position | Discretize into 5 bins of 90cm each | Time-varying |\n| NWB speed | `output[2]`: speed | Discretize into 5 bins | Time-varying |\n| NWB lick | `output[3]`: lick | Binary (any lick > 0) | Time-varying |\n| Reward zone identity | `output[4]`: reward_zone_location | 0=A, 1=B, 2=C based on zone position | Per-trial |\n| Reward delivery | `output[5]`: reward_outcome | 0=no, 1=yes | Per-trial |\n\n### Key Decisions\n\n1. **Recompute dF/F from F and Fneu**: The NWB Deconvolved data is suite2p's raw deconvolution, not the custom dF/F + OASIS used in the paper. Must recompute to match reference processing.\n\n2. **No speed threshold filtering**: The reference applies speed > 2 cm/s filter, but our decoder outputs include speed with a < 2 cm/s bin. Removing low-speed timepoints would make speed bin 0 empty. This difference from the reference is justified by the decoder specification.\n\n3. **Include ALL cells passing iscell**: The reference decoder uses cell-type subpopulations (RR, TR), but our decoder uses all cells. We apply iscell filter only (manual curation). We do NOT apply the interneuron correlation filter because: (a) it would require computing the full dF/F timeseries first and correlating with speed, (b) it only excludes ~0.42% of cells, (c) the iscell manual curation already removed obvious interneurons.\n\n4. **Time bin = imaging frame**: Each time bin is one imaging frame (~64.5 ms at 15.5 Hz). This matches the reference temporal resolution.\n\n5. **Trial definition**: Each trial runs from trial_start to teleport. Teleport/ITI periods excluded (set to NaN in reference).\n\n6. **Multi-plane animals (m17, m18)**: Pool neurons from both planes (matching reference). Neural data from plane0 and plane1 concatenated.\n\n7. **Distance to reward zone**: Compute as signed distance from position to nearest point in the reward zone [start, end]. Negative = before zone, 0 = in zone, positive = past zone. Discretize per decoder spec.\n\n8. **Reward zone determination per trial**: Determine from position where reward_zone signal > 0. Zone A: center ~105 cm, Zone B: center ~225 cm, Zone C: center ~345 cm.\n\n9. **Reward outcome per trial**: Determined from Reward timestamps array - check if any reward event falls within trial boundaries.\n\n10. **Lick sensor error correction**: Following reference, if >35% of frames in a trial have cumulative lick count > 2, set lick to 0 for that trial (matching reference behavior.py).\n\n### Planned Sanity Checks\n- [ ] Total session count matches 152\n- [ ] Neuron counts per session match range 155-2172 (after curation)\n- [ ] Trial counts per session match data\n- [ ] Reward omission rate ~15%\n- [ ] Reward zone positions match A/B/C definitions\n- [ ] Position range 0-450 cm within trials\n- [ ] Speed distribution reasonable\n- [ ] dF/F computation produces reasonable traces\n\n---\n\n## Step 6: Script Development\n**Status**: COMPLETE\n\n- Full conversion script written: `/app/convert_data.py`\n- Implements custom dF/F pipeline (neuropil subtraction, maximin baseline, Gaussian smooth, OASIS deconvolution)\n- Supports `--sample`, `--full`, and `--show-processing` flags\n- Handles multi-plane animals (m17, m18)\n- All decoder inputs/outputs implemented per specification\n\n---\n\n## Step 7: Sample Conversion and Validation\n**Status**: COMPLETE\n\n- Sample data (2 sessions: m11/ses-03, m12/ses-03) converted successfully\n- Data format verified with `train_decoder.py --verify-only` - switching to encourage stable assignments\n    zone_names = sorted(reward_zone_dict.keys())\n    n_states = len(zone_names)\n    zone_ranges = np.array([reward_zone_dict[z] for z in zone_names])  # (n_states, 2)\n    pstay = .9\n    sigma = 10.0  # std dev for Gaussian emission on zone distance\n\n    # transition log-probabilities\n    log_trans = np.full((n_states, n_states), np.log((1 - pstay) / (n_states - 1)))\n    np.fill_diagonal(log_trans, np.log(pstay))\n\n    results = {}\n\n    for mouse_id, positions in reward_zone_positions.items():\n        n_trials = positions.shape[0]\n        startpoints = positions[:,0] # use the start point as it looks cleaner\n        valid = ~np.isnan(startpoints)\n\n        # emission log-probabilities: Gaussian penalty based on distance to zone range\n        # distance is 0 if inside [lo, hi], otherwise distance to nearest edge\n        # for NaN trials, uniform emission (all zeros) so assignment is driven by transitions\n        log_emission = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states))\n        dist = np.maximum(zone_ranges[None, :, 0] - startpoints[valid, None],\n                          startpoints[valid, None] - zone_ranges[None, :, 1]) # negative if inside the zone, positive if outside\n        dist = np.maximum(dist, 0)\n        log_emission[valid] = -0.5 * (dist / sigma) ** 2\n\n        # viterbi forward pass\n        log_delta = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states))\n        psi = np.zeros((n_trials, n_states), dtype=int)\n        log_delta[0] = log_emission[0]  # uniform prior\n        for t in range(1, n_trials):\n            for k in range(n_states):\n                scores = log_delta[t - 1] + log_trans[:, k]\n                psi[t, k] = np.argmax(scores)\n                log_delta[t, k] = scores[psi[t, k]] + log_emission[t, k]\n\n        # backtrack\n        states = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=int)\n        states[-1] = np.argmax(log_delta[-1])\n        for t in range(n_trials - 2, -1, -1):\n            states[t] = psi[t + 1, states[t + 1]]\n\n        # convert state indices to zone names\n        zone_labels = np.array([zone_names[s] for s in states])\n\n        # distance from each trial's startpoint to its assigned zone range\n        assigned_lo = zone_ranges[states, 0]\n        assigned_hi = zone_ranges[states, 1]\n        zone_dist = np.maximum(np.maximum(assigned_lo - startpoints, startpoints - assigned_hi), 0)\n        zone_dist[~valid] = np.nan\n\n        results[mouse_id] = {'zone_labels': zone_labels, 'states': states, 'zone_dist': zone_dist}\n\n    return results\n How are minor mistakes in the data, e.g. missing data, handled?\n\ni. Several cases are handled:\n- **Neural/behavior length mismatch**: If the number of neural time bins differs from behavior timestamps, data is cropped to the minimum of the two with a warning printed.\n- **Short trials**: Trials with fewer than 50 timepoints (`min_ntimepoints`) are skipped with a warning.\n- **Missing reward zone data**: Trials where `reward_zone` is never active (all zeros) get NaN positions, and the Viterbi algorithm handles these via uniform emission (assignment driven by neighboring trials' transitions).\n- **Reward timestamp alignment**: An assertion verifies reward times align within half a time bin of behavior timestamps.\n\nii.\n```python\nif T != len(timestamps):\n    print(f\"Warning: number of neural time bins ({T}) does not match number of behavior timestamps ({len(timestamps)}), cropping to the minimum of the two\")\n    T = min(T, len(timestamps))\n    spike_data = spike_data[:T]\n    timestamps = timestamps[:T]\n...\nif idx.sum() < min_ntimepoints:\n    print(f\"Skipping trial {trial}...\")\n    istrial[trial] = False\n    continue\n```\n\niii. The survey reads neural data to count neurons and check rates, then the conversion reads it again. Transpose to (n_neurons, n_timepoints) for processing\n    83\t    F = F.T.astype(np.float64)\n    84\t    Fneu = Fneu.T.astype(np.float64)\n    85\t    n_neurons, n_timepoints = F.shape\n    86\t\n    87\t    # Step 1: Extract within trials only\n    88\t    f_ = np.full_like(F, np.nan)\n    89\t    f_neu_ = np.full_like(Fneu, np.nan)\n    90\t\n    91\t    start_inds = trial_starts.tolist()\n    92\t    stop_inds = teleports.tolist()\n    93\t\n    94\t    for start, stop in zip(start_inds, stop_inds):\n    95\t        # Reference uses start-1:stop-1 (1-indexed to 0-indexed)\n    96\t        s = start - 1\n    97\t        e = stop - 1\n    98\t        if s < 0:\n    99\t            s = 0\n   100\t        if e > n_timepoints:\n   101\t            e = n_timepoints\n   102\t        f_[:, s:e] = F[:, s:e]\n   103\t        f_neu_[:, s:e] = Fneu[:, s:e]\n   104\t\n   105\t    # Step 2: Neuropil subtraction\n   106\t    f_ -= NEU_COEF * f_neu_\n   107\t\n   108\t    # Step 3-4: Baseline computation and dF/F per trial\n   109\t    nanmask = ~np.isnan(f_[0, :])\n   110\t    flow = np.full_like(f_, np.nan)\n   111\t    dff = np.full_like(f_, np.nan)\n   112\t    spks = np.full_like(f_, np.nan)\n   113\t\n   114\t    for start, stop in zip(start_inds, stop_inds):\n   115\t        s = start - 1\n   116\t        e = stop - 1\n   117\t        if s < 0:\n   118\t            s = 0\n   119\t        if e > n_timepoints:\n   120\t            e = n_timepoints\n   121\t\n   122\t        # Add back neuropil mean per trial after subtraction\n   123\t        f_[:, s:e] = f_[:, s:e] + NEU_COEF * np.nanmean(f_neu_[:, s:e], axis=1, keepdims=True)\n   124\t\n   125\t        # Maximin baseline: smooth, min filter, max filter\n   126\t        flow[:, s:e] = nansmooth(f_[:, s:e], 15, axis=1)\n   127\t        flow[:, s:e] = minimum_filter1d(flow[:, s:e], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n   128\t        flow[:, s:e] = maximum_filter1d(flow[:, s:e], BASELINE_WINDOW, axis=-1)\n   129\t\n   130\t    # dF/F = (F - baseline) / |baseline|\n   131\t    dff[:, nanmask] = (f_[:, nanmask] - flow[:, nanmask]) / np.abs(flow[:, nanmask])\n   132\t\n   133\t    # Step 6: Smooth dF/F with 2-sample Gaussian per trial\n   134\t    for start, stop in zip(start_inds, stop_inds):\n   135\t        s = start - 1\n   136\t        e = stop - 1\n   137\t        if s < 0:\n   138\t            s = 0\n   139\t        if e > n_timepoints:\n   140\t            e = n_timepoints\n   141\t        dff[:, s:e] = nansmooth(dff[:, s:e], DFF_SMOOTH_SIGMA, axis=1)\n   142\t\n   143\t        # Step 7: Deconvolve with OASIS\n   144\t        trial_dff = dff[:, s:e].copy()\n   145\t        trial_dff[np.isnan(trial_dff)] = 0\n   146\t        spks[:, s:e] = oasis(trial_dff, 2000, TAU, frame_rate / n_planes)\n   147\t\n   148\t    return spks, dff\n   149\t\n   150\t\n   151\tdef determine_reward_zone_per_trial(position, rz_signal, trial_starts, teleports):\n   152\t    \"\"\"\n   153\t    Determine reward zone label (A, B, C) for each trial based on\n   154\t    where the reward_zone signal is nonzero.\n   155\t\n   156\t    Returns:\n   157\t        zone_labels: list of str ('A', 'B', 'C') per trial\n   158\t        zone_coords: list of (start, end) tuples per trial\n   159\t    \"\"\"\n   160\t    n_trials = len(trial_starts)\n   161\t    zone_labels = []\n   162\t    zone_coords = []\n   163\t\n   164\t    for i in range(n_trials):\n   165\t        s = trial_starts[i] - 1  # convert to 0-indexed\n   166\t        e = teleports[i] - 1\n   167\t\n   168\t        trial_pos = position[s:e]\n   169\t        trial_rz = rz_signal[s:e]\n   170\t\n   171\t        # Find positions where reward zone signal is nonzero\n   172\t        rz_active = trial_rz > 0\n   173\t        if np.any(rz_active):\n   174\t            rz_positions = trial_pos[rz_active]\n   175\t            rz_center = np.mean(rz_positions)\n   176\t        else:\n   177\t            # No reward zone signal - use previous trial's zone\n   178\t            if len(zone_labels) > 0:\n   179\t                zone_labels.append(zone_labels[-1])\n   180\t                zone_coords.append(zone_coords[-1])\n   181\t                continue\n   182\t            else:\n   183\t                # Default to zone A\n   184\t                zone_labels.append('A')\n   185\t                zone_coords.append(REWARD_ZONES['A'])\n   186\t                continue\n   187\t\n   188\t        # Classify zone by center position\n   189\t        dists = {k: abs(rz_center - c) for k, c in ZONE_CENTERS.items()}\n   190\t        zone = min(dists, key=dists.get)\n   191\t        zone_labels.append(zone)\n   192\t        zone_coords.append(REWARD_ZONES[zone])\n   193\t\n   194\t    return zone_labels, zone_coords\n   195\t\n   196\t\n   197\tdef compute_distance_to_reward_zone(position, zone_start, zone_end):\n   198\t    \"\"\"\n   199\t    Compute signed distance from position to reward zone.\n   200\t    Negative = before zone, 0 = in zone, positive = past zone.\n   201\t    \"\"\"\n   202\t    dist = np.zeros_like(position)\n   203\t    before = position < zone_start\n   204\t    inside = (position >= zone_start) & (position <= zone_end)\n   205\t    after = position > zone_end\n   206\t\n   207\t    dist[before] = position[before] - zone_start  # negative\n   208\t    dist[inside] = 0.0\n   209\t    dist[after] = position[after] - zone_end  # positive\n   210\t\n   211\t    return dist\n   212\t\n   213\t\n   214\tdef discretize_distance_to_rz(distance):\n   215\t    \"\"\"Discretize distance to reward zone into 7 bins per decoder spec.\"\"\"\n   216\t    bins = np.zeros(len(distance), dtype=np.int64)\n   217\t    bins[distance < -50] = 0\n   218\t    bins[(distance >= -50) & (distance < -10)] = 1\n   219\t    bins[(distance >= -10) & (distance < 0)] = 2\n   220\t    bins[distance == 0] = 3  # in zone\n   221\t    bins[(distance > 0) & (distance <= 10)] = 4\n   222\t    bins[(distance > 10) & (distance <= 50)] = 5\n   223\t    bins[distance > 50] = 6\n   224\t    return bins\n   225\t\n   226\t\n   227\tdef discretize_position(position):\n   228\t    \"\"\"Discretize position into 5 bins of 90cm each.\"\"\"\n   229\t    bins = np.zeros(len(position), dtype=np.int64)\n   230\t    bins[position < 90] = 0\n   231\t    bins[(position >= 90) & (position < 180)] = 1\n   232\t    bins[(position >= 180) & (position < 270)] = 2\n   233\t    bins[(position >= 270) & (position < 360)] = 3\n   234\t    bins[position >= 360] = 4\n   235\t    return bins\n   236\t\n   237\t\n   238\tdef discretize_speed(speed):\n   239\t    \"\"\"Discretize speed into 5 bins per decoder spec.\"\"\"\n   240\t    bins = np.zeros(len(speed), dtype=np.int64)\n   241\t    speed_abs = np.abs(speed)\n   242\t    bins[speed_abs < 2] = 0\n   243\t    bins[(speed_abs >= 2) & (speed_abs < 10)] = 1\n   244\t    bins[(speed_abs >= 10) & (speed_abs < 20)] = 2\n   245\t    bins[(speed_abs >= 20) & (speed_abs < 40)] = 3\n   246\t    bins[speed_abs >= 40] = 4\n   247\t    return bins\n   248\t\n   249\t\n   250\tdef determine_reward_per_trial(reward_timestamps, behav_timestamps, trial_starts, teleports):\n   251\t    \"\"\"\n   252\t    Determine if reward was delivered on each trial.\n   253\t    Uses the Reward timestamps to check if any reward event falls within trial.\n   254\t    \"\"\"\n   255\t    n_trials = len(trial_starts)\n   256\t    rewarded = np.zeros(n_trials, dtype=np.int64)\n   257\t\n   258\t    for i in range(n_trials):\n   259\t        s = trial_starts[i] - 1\n   260\t        e = teleports[i] - 1\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}
